questions.question: Which of the following functions cannot be frequency response of a discrete-time LTI system?
The signal $x[n]=1+\sin (n)+\sin (\pi n)$ is given as input to a low pass filter with cut-off frequency of 2. Select the correct statement from the following:
If the magnitude response of an LTI system is constant and the phase response is linear, then the input and output are related by
options: output signal is a scaled and delayed version of the input signal
output signal is always a scaled version of the input signal
output signal is always a delayed version of the input signal

answers.a: output signal is a scaled and delayed version of the input signal
answers.b: output signal is always a scaled version of the input signal
answers.c: output signal is always a delayed version of the input signal

questions.question: If the input to an LTI system is $x[n]=e^{j n}$, the system output
options: is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n}$
is always of the form $y[n]=e^{j n}$
is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n+j \phi}$

answers.a: is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n}$
answers.b: is always of the form $y[n]=e^{j n}$
answers.c: is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n+j \phi}$
